E1336

An environment image cannot project a service, verified package output, or extra file

What

An environment image cannot project a service, verified package output, or extra file

Why

D-ENV-IMAGE1 keeps image layers tied to verified Hangar output and explicit safe project files. A service needs the typed supervisor; an absent, empty, conflicting, or wrong-platform package output, or a missing, unsafe, or secret extra file cannot be copied into an image.

Fix

Run the declared service through `jetpack services`, realize the environment package for the image target, or choose a regular project-relative non-secret extra file and run `jet image` again.
